experimentalType: fresh-seed prospective A/B/A policy cohort; one unchanged New Moon candidate 60 against four authenticated original Aichi source lists, both physical source seats for every source rank; native attack-settlement and reciprocal-sequence screens enabled
sourceSeatAllocationRule: Each original source rank appears twice: candidateSlot B places the original source in physical seat 0; candidateSlot A places the original source in physical seat 1. Each rank therefore covers both physical source seats.
seedOrigin: Eight independent secrets.randbits(32) draws executed on the Python runtime before this registration and before any native run: rank1/A=866485604, rank1/B=1551119314, rank3/A=1634405212, rank3/B=4137534982, rank6/A=3827289565, rank6/B=4131643824, rank11/A=3249368238, rank11/B=1279416371.
policyLayers: All phases use the same source-independent bilateral v8 common policy, Telepath owner-only ChooseCards continuation, owner-only Radiant Eternatus/Articuno-GX Confirm policy, Radiant zero-search correction, owner Prize/Promotion continuation, bilateral Volt continuation and Thorns direct-root flag. Only phase B enables the existing canonical actor inner ownerVipAfterPass handler through AGENT9_BATTLE_VIP_AFTER_PASS_DEV=true; A and A2 leave it disabled.
randomnessProtocol: isolatePolicyRandomness=true and isolatePhysicalShuffleRandomnessAfterSetup=true for all phases. Each phase reuses identical registered trial IDs, fixed candidate/source 60s, physical seat allocation and seed. No seed selection or root filtering after results. Actual first-player seat is captured from the native setup coin-choice receipt and must be reported across both seats; the registration does not infer it from candidateSlot.
controlProtocol: A/B/A in fixed order. Compare sourceDealFingerprint and fullPhysicalDealFingerprint within each exact trial. A2 must reproduce A's public root ledger and outcome. B's first root-ledger divergence is attributed to the VIP treatment only if it is a genuine Battle VIP Pass PlayCardAction replacing the same owner's PassTurnAction; otherwise record the actual divergence without treating it as a VIP effect.
rootCensoring: 260 accepted native root actions per arm. Native terminal, engine error, early return and root cap are retained separately. A capped game is not a win or loss. The 260-root ceiling is a development horizon, not a completed-game guarantee.
evidencePlan: Capture public accepted roots, native setup coin-choice receipt, settled source and candidate attack transitions, actual physical source/candidate seats, source/full physical-deal fingerprints, owner-only VIP prompt outcomes, and Agent45 general/source-attack/source-return sequence screens. All sequence screens are observational and remain paper/causal/policy unqualified.
scopeLimitations: Only four of the 29 authenticated source lists are included. New Moon is a provisional English mechanics-equivalent proxy; its exact Japanese print manifest is archived but paper-legal physical printings remain unverified. This cohort does not establish full-field performance, a completed paper-valid game, official 25-minute clock compliance, or any win-rate estimate.
